PROCUREMENT POLICY
Policy Code: PRC-006
Title: Purchase Integrity and Special Cases
Version: 1.0
Effective Date: 2025-06-01
Category: integrity
Company: Northwind Industrial Co.
1. Split Purchases
1.1 Purchases must not be split into smaller orders to avoid an approval threshold or
    quotation requirement.
1.2 Purchases from the same supplier in the same category within 30 days are combined
    when determining the approval level.
2. Justification
2.1 Every purchase request must include a business justification.
2.2 Purchases of items outside the standard catalog must be accompanied by a reasonable
    justification.
3. Emergency Purchases
3.1 An emergency purchase is one needed to prevent immediate harm to people, property or
    operations.
3.2 Emergency purchases require retrospective approval within 3 business days.
3.3 Emergency purchases above USD 5,000 still require at least two written quotations
    where feasible.
4. Duplicate Requests
4.1 Requests that duplicate an open request for the same items and supplier must be
    rejected or merged.
SYNTHETIC DATA - fictional company and vendors, not a real document
